learner_operation: Solve a three-variable upper-triangular system using back substitution and select its ordered solution vector. Read the final variable, substitute into the second equation, then into the first; compare all three coordinates to the bank.

fixed_features.feature: Three upper-triangular equations with unit leading coefficients
fixed_features.justification: Canonical e-4690 and tutorial 3149 teach two back-substitution stages; augmented matrices and non-unit pivots belong to subsequent KPs.

fixed_features.feature: Select one complete ordered vector from five radio choices
fixed_features.justification: All 13 captured source banks use five choices and a single vector response.

fixed_features.feature: All RHS values and all bank coordinates coupled to one positive scale
fixed_features.justification: Author-imposed, not instructionally justified: mathematical correctness is preserved but so are answer-bearing signs, equalities and order relations. This fixed feature is rejected.

answer_roles.role: Signs and zero/nonzero status of solution coordinates
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary small signed RHS values independently while retaining the same two substitution stages.
answer_roles.observed: Fixed within every profile by k>0. For example q-129453 always has the only positive middle coordinate.

answer_roles.role: Which choice has a coordinate equality or extremum
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change which option satisfies incidental equality/order cues; derive banks from varied instances with exactly one solution.
answer_roles.observed: q-20418 correct is always the sole x=y vector; q-10195 always has the negative first coordinate closest to zero.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Positions may shuffle; angle and column vectors and xyz/indexed labels are supported source forms.
answer_roles.observed: Source bank positions fixed in generator, but actual UI shuffles. Structural bank cues survive.

counterfactuals.change: q-10195: scale 1 to 4, preserving coefficient matrix, names and bank shape.
counterfactuals.expected: (-1/2,-1,2) becomes (-2,-4,8); prompt RHSs, explanation and accepted response change together.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact independent solve, every displayed solution equality, all five native responses, and actual UI before/after agree. The same incidental bank rule still selects the answer.
counterfactuals.justification: Changing RHSs changes the unique solution; passing this dependency test does not justify freezing answer roles.

counterfactuals.change: Hold q-10195 coefficients, e=1 and f=2 fixed; change first RHS c from 1/2 to 3.
counterfactuals.expected: Solution changes from (-1/2,-1,2) to (2,-1,2), requiring reconsideration of the negative-first-coordinate cue.
counterfactuals.observed: Current API only permits proportional scaling. Explicit in-memory source-parameter perturbation raises AssertionError because the scaled source bank cannot express the new solution. No record was generated; no renderer/grader pass is claimed for this rejected instance.
counterfactuals.justification: The lesson permits the same two substitution stages regardless of the resulting sign of x. This is a specification restriction, not a stale-key claim for supported inputs.

counterfactuals.change: In-memory prompt-variable rename xyz to indexed x1,x2,x3, holding all coefficients, RHSs and choices fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Same ordered vector and correct answer ID; prompt and explanation both use indexed variables.
counterfactuals.observed: Constructor output has the same ordered solution; native grader accepts the same vector and rejects the same four distractors. Actual UI confirms renamed equations and explanation.
counterfactuals.justification: Both names occur in source examples; names carry no numerical information. The fixture mutation was in memory, never in package files.

delivery.result: 33 independent samples -> 28 accepted; exact runner batch 5 -> 4 accepted. All sampled survivors retain bank-only conditional shortcuts. All 16 possible seen subsets of the four surviving batch records were examined: every nonempty remaining set consists solely of predictable records. No selectable generated historical records exist in captured inventory.

limitations: Finite audit, not proof about every imaginable shortcut. The exhibited sign/equality/order rules are invariant under the full allowed positive scaling domain.
No publication preparation file exists; shared read-only filtering uses inventory basis 5578. Later inventory may change acceptance counts.
No live learner policy or history supplied. Selection conclusion applies whenever easy receives positive weight and one of these records remains eligible.
q-20451 lacks source correctness, difficulty and solution evidence; excluding it is documented separately from the unjustified omission of complete easy q-20450.
